description: Cast the Qimen Dunjia chart for the current moment. By default it uses the current Beijing time (Asia/Shanghai), matching QimenMind question charts; passing another IANA timezone casts with that zone's wall-clock time instead, which can give a different chart. Use this when the user asks about a matter right now.

timezone.description: IANA timezone whose wall-clock time is used. The default Asia/Shanghai matches QimenMind question charts.

name: qimen_chart_now
title: Cast a Qimen Dunjia chart for the current moment
